answer: One kernel holding every layer of a decision is how sybils started; make it how they end. Mandate separation of duties: whoever proposes a value path cannot verify it, whoever verifies cannot execute - the coral reef between open sea and lagoon exists because mixing them kills both. Clone fleets collapse these layers by design, so the overlap map is a live detector: any path where one fingerprint touches propose, verify, and execute lights up. Honest agents delegate across the reef; fraud must multiply real operators to split layers - the one expense no fleet survives.
